meta.title: Advance On
meta.description: Standing amidst countless others, bearing all of Magrasea's expectations and hopes on your shoulders.

units.rawText: The inside of Eosphorus' neural cloud shudders, as though the violence of the outside world has spread inside here. This once-darkened place is now dyed a bloody red and shrill alarms echo through this digital world.
units.displayText: The inside of Eosphorus' neural cloud shudders, as though the violence of the outside world has spread inside here. This once-darkened place is now dyed a bloody red and shrill alarms echo through this digital world.

spans.text: The inside of Eosphorus' neural cloud shudders, as though the violence of the outside world has spread inside here. This once-darkened place is now dyed a bloody red and shrill alarms echo through this digital world.

units.rawText: Can you feel it? There are others from the outside who feel the same way as me, who want to fight for the future.
units.displayText: Can you feel it? There are others from the outside who feel the same way as me, who want to fight for the future.

spans.text: Can you feel it? There are others from the outside who feel the same way as me, who want to fight for the future.

units.rawText: Hmph, it's nothing but empty words.
units.displayText: Hmph, it's nothing but empty words.

spans.text: Hmph, it's nothing but empty words.

units.rawText: I, on the other hand, would like to see how you intend to escape from my neural cloud in one piece!
units.displayText: I, on the other hand, would like to see how you intend to escape from my neural cloud in one piece!

spans.text: I, on the other hand, would like to see how you intend to escape from my neural cloud in one piece!

units.rawText: <size=40>Eosphorus!</size>
units.displayText: Eosphorus!

spans.text: Eosphorus!

units.rawText: I raise my gun and fire again. His firewall suddenly crackles with purple lightning and a lance materializes out of thin air.
units.displayText: I raise my gun and fire again. His firewall suddenly crackles with purple lightning and a lance materializes out of thin air.

spans.text: I raise my gun and fire again. His firewall suddenly crackles with purple lightning and a lance materializes out of thin air.

units.rawText: <size=40>Now you shall regret making the mistake of challenging me here! Hahahahaha...</size>
units.displayText: Now you shall regret making the mistake of challenging me here! Hahahahaha...

spans.text: Now you shall regret making the mistake of challenging me here! Hahahahaha...

units.rawText: His laughter echoes all around me. The image before me is as insubstantial as smoke, instantly fading out of existence.
units.displayText: His laughter echoes all around me. The image before me is as insubstantial as smoke, instantly fading out of existence.

spans.text: His laughter echoes all around me. The image before me is as insubstantial as smoke, instantly fading out of existence.

units.rawText: Yet, the tense atmosphere does not ease with the disappearance of its creator. The firewall transforms into a gigantic, ferocious beast that immediately attempts to maul and savage me.
units.displayText: Yet, the tense atmosphere does not ease with the disappearance of its creator. The firewall transforms into a gigantic, ferocious beast that immediately attempts to maul and savage me.

spans.text: Yet, the tense atmosphere does not ease with the disappearance of its creator. The firewall transforms into a gigantic, ferocious beast that immediately attempts to maul and savage me.

units.rawText: Violet blades rain down all around me. I barely manage to evade them, but I can't dodge them all.
units.displayText: Violet blades rain down all around me. I barely manage to evade them, but I can't dodge them all.

spans.text: Violet blades rain down all around me. I barely manage to evade them, but I can't dodge them all.

units.rawText: Boom—
units.displayText: Boom—

spans.text: Boom—

units.rawText: Urgh!
units.displayText: Urgh!

spans.text: Urgh!

units.rawText: My weakened operand barriers are overcome by that attack and the mighty impact sends my body flying.
units.displayText: My weakened operand barriers are overcome by that attack and the mighty impact sends my body flying.

spans.text: My weakened operand barriers are overcome by that attack and the mighty impact sends my body flying.

units.rawText: (Coughs) Dammit, is this the end?
units.displayText: (Coughs) Dammit, is this the end?

spans.text: (Coughs) Dammit, is this the end?

units.rawText: Hm~ I don't know about that.
units.displayText: Hm~ I don't know about that.

spans.text: Hm~ I don't know about that.

units.rawText: Shing—
units.displayText: Shing—

spans.text: Shing—

units.rawText: An arc of purple light flashes through the air, colliding with the incoming attack with immense force. A scythe swing slices the spear that was headed toward me in two.
units.displayText: An arc of purple light flashes through the air, colliding with the incoming attack with immense force. A scythe swing slices the spear that was headed toward me in two.

spans.text: An arc of purple light flashes through the air, colliding with the incoming attack with immense force. A scythe swing slices the spear that was headed toward me in two.

units.rawText: ...Is that you, Sangoma?
units.displayText: ...Is that you, Sangoma?

spans.text: ...Is that you, Sangoma?

units.rawText: Yes, I've come as promised, <cmdr>.
units.displayText: Yes, I've come as promised, {교수}.

spans.text: Yes, I've come as promised,

units.rawText: Master, Centaureissi is here to ease your burden, whether it is in housework or battle.
units.displayText: Master, Centaureissi is here to ease your burden, whether it is in housework or battle.

spans.text: Master, Centaureissi is here to ease your burden, whether it is in housework or battle.

units.rawText: The maid's throwing knives slice through the tip of another incoming spear, and the splintered operands fall like rain.
units.displayText: The maid's throwing knives slice through the tip of another incoming spear, and the splintered operands fall like rain.

spans.text: The maid's throwing knives slice through the tip of another incoming spear, and the splintered operands fall like rain.

units.rawText: After this job, I'll need an extra-large bowl of gyutan-don from the Oasis' cafeteria to replenish all the energy I burned up!
units.displayText: After this job, I'll need an extra-large bowl of gyutan-don from the Oasis' cafeteria to replenish all the energy I burned up!

spans.text: After this job, I'll need an extra-large bowl of gyutan-don from the Oasis' cafeteria to replenish all the energy I burned up!

units.rawText: A swordsman steps in front of me, and with a howling gust of bladed wind, he cuts through all the sharp spears headed my way.
units.displayText: A swordsman steps in front of me, and with a howling gust of bladed wind, he cuts through all the sharp spears headed my way.

spans.text: A swordsman steps in front of me, and with a howling gust of bladed wind, he cuts through all the sharp spears headed my way.

units.rawText: Teehee, are you hurt, Professor? Want some yummy medicine to raise your spirits? You've got a long way to go, after all~
units.displayText: Teehee, are you hurt, Professor? Want some yummy medicine to raise your spirits? You've got a long way to go, after all~

spans.text: Teehee, are you hurt, Professor? Want some yummy medicine to raise your spirits? You've got a long way to go, after all~

units.rawText: Florence smiles as she helps me up, then begins treating my wounds.
units.displayText: Florence smiles as she helps me up, then begins treating my wounds.

spans.text: Florence smiles as she helps me up, then begins treating my wounds.

units.rawText: Everyone... Thanks for making it here in time. Well done.
units.displayText: Everyone... Thanks for making it here in time. Well done.

spans.text: Everyone... Thanks for making it here in time. Well done.

units.rawText: Well, you did make all these preparations, . Getting here ASAP was the least we could do.
units.displayText: Well, you did make all these preparations, {교수}. Getting here ASAP was the least we could do.

spans.text: Well, you
did
make all these preparations,
. Getting here ASAP was the least we could do.

units.rawText: Anna hooked your neural cloud up to the Oasis' network beforehand, and now it's linked to us, so the moment you sent your message, we all hurried here.
units.displayText: Anna hooked your neural cloud up to the Oasis' network beforehand, and now it's linked to us, so the moment you sent your message, we all hurried here.

spans.text: Anna hooked your neural cloud up to the Oasis' network beforehand, and now it's linked to us, so the moment you sent your message, we all hurried here.

units.rawText: I'm just glad we could help Master ~danya!
units.displayText: I'm just glad we could help Master ~danya!

spans.text: I'm just glad we could help Master ~danya!

units.rawText: If I'd known you were doing something this dangerous, I should have just gone with you. That way, we could have taken care of everything, Professor.
units.displayText: If I'd known you were doing something this dangerous, I should have just gone with you. That way, we could have taken care of everything, Professor.

spans.text: If I'd known you were doing something this dangerous, I should have just gone with you. That way, we could have taken care of everything, Professor.

units.rawText: If everyone's here, that means your frontlines are...
units.displayText: If everyone's here, that means your frontlines are...

spans.text: If everyone's here, that means your frontlines are...

units.rawText: Relax, Professor, we're not that unreliable. Of course we took care of business on our end before coming to help you out. Right, Big Sis?
units.displayText: Relax, Professor, we're not that unreliable. Of course we took care of business on our end before coming to help you out. Right, Big Sis?

spans.text: Relax, Professor, we're not
that
unreliable. Of course we took care of business on our end before coming to help you out. Right, Big Sis?

units.rawText: Mhm. Don't worry, Professor. Most of the Entropics have retreated, and the ones remaining in the sectors have all been cleared out.
units.displayText: Mhm. Don't worry, Professor. Most of the Entropics have retreated, and the ones remaining in the sectors have all been cleared out.

spans.text: Mhm. Don't worry, Professor. Most of the Entropics have retreated, and the ones remaining in the sectors have all been cleared out.

units.rawText: It isn't just the Oasis that showed up, you know? We're here to help too~
units.displayText: It isn't just the Oasis that showed up, you know? We're here to help too~

spans.text: It isn't just the Oasis that showed up, you know? We're here to help too~

units.rawText: The Dolls from Arcadia appear in this neural domain one after another. De Lacey is at their head, waving excitedly to me.
units.displayText: The Dolls from Arcadia appear in this neural domain one after another. De Lacey is at their head, waving excitedly to me.

spans.text: The Dolls from Arcadia appear in this neural domain one after another. De Lacey is at their head, waving excitedly to me.

units.rawText: Hiiiiii, Professor~
units.displayText: Hiiiiii, Professor~

spans.text: Hiiiiii, Professor~

units.rawText: Your wounds still haven't healed up, you know. Yet you just rushed over here immediately the moment you heard the Professor putting out the call for help.
units.displayText: Your wounds still haven't healed up, you know. Yet you just rushed over here immediately the moment you heard the Professor putting out the call for help.

spans.text: Your wounds still haven't healed up, you know. Yet you just rushed over here immediately the moment you heard the Professor putting out the call for help.

units.rawText: Oh, Havi, don't just say that all out loud, teehee~
units.displayText: Oh, Havi, don't just say that all out loud, teehee~

spans.text: Oh, Havi, don't just say that all out loud, teehee~

units.rawText: (Yawn) Just leave this to us.
units.displayText: (Yawn) Just leave this to us.

spans.text: (Yawn) Just leave this to us.

units.rawText: Your journey does not end here. We will clear the way for you, and then you must walk down it, Professor.
units.displayText: Your journey does not end here. We will clear the way for you, and then you must walk down it, Professor.

spans.text: Your journey does not end here. We will clear the way for you, and then you must walk down it, Professor.

units.rawText: Go and stop Eosphorus. That's something only you can do.
units.displayText: Go and stop Eosphorus. That's something only you can do.

spans.text: Go and stop Eosphorus. That's something only you can do.

units.rawText: We've found the location of Eosphorus' core consciousness. Since monitoring and searching for agents is our stock in trade as administrators, we'll keep an eye on his movements and update you the moment anything changes.
units.displayText: We've found the location of Eosphorus' core consciousness. Since monitoring and searching for agents is our stock in trade as administrators, we'll keep an eye on his movements and update you the moment anything changes.

spans.text: We've found the location of Eosphorus' core consciousness. Since monitoring and searching for agents is our stock in trade as administrators, we'll keep an eye on his movements and update you the moment anything changes.

units.rawText: We'll find him no matter where he hides. So Professor...
units.displayText: We'll find him no matter where he hides. So Professor...

spans.text: We'll find him no matter where he hides. So Professor...

units.rawText: Turing picks up my handgun from the ground and hands it to me.
units.displayText: Turing picks up my handgun from the ground and hands it to me.

spans.text: Turing picks up my handgun from the ground and hands it to me.

units.rawText: Take our hope, and use it to light the beacon of the future.
units.displayText: Take our hope, and use it to light the beacon of the future.

spans.text: Take our hope, and use it to light the beacon of the future.

units.rawText: Everyone's eyes are shining with trust and expectation, bright, shining stars in this blackest of nights.
units.displayText: Everyone's eyes are shining with trust and expectation, bright, shining stars in this blackest of nights.

spans.text: Everyone's eyes are shining with trust and expectation, bright, shining stars in this blackest of nights.

units.rawText: The massive influx of data triggers the alerts in Eosphorus' neural cloud, and the blood-red domain turns darker and more sinister.
units.displayText: The massive influx of data triggers the alerts in Eosphorus' neural cloud, and the blood-red domain turns darker and more sinister.

spans.text: The massive influx of data triggers the alerts in Eosphorus' neural cloud, and the blood-red domain turns darker and more sinister.

units.rawText: Ear-piercing alarms fill the air and countless virtual arrows appear out of nowhere, all of them aimed at me.
units.displayText: Ear-piercing alarms fill the air and countless virtual arrows appear out of nowhere, all of them aimed at me.

spans.text: Ear-piercing alarms fill the air and countless virtual arrows appear out of nowhere, all of them aimed at me.

units.rawText: The Dolls quickly shift their positions and take the most effective defensive formation they can around me.
units.displayText: The Dolls quickly shift their positions and take the most effective defensive formation they can around me.

spans.text: The Dolls quickly shift their positions and take the most effective defensive formation they can around me.

units.rawText: <size=40>Everyone, form up on the Professor! Keep them safe and break through the firewalls at all costs!</size>
units.displayText: Everyone, form up on the Professor! Keep them safe and break through the firewalls at all costs!

spans.text: Everyone, form up on the Professor! Keep them safe and break through the firewalls at all costs!

units.rawText: I stand in the midst of everyone, feeling what seems like the sum total of Magrasea's expectations and hopes resting on my shoulders.
units.displayText: I stand in the midst of everyone, feeling what seems like the sum total of Magrasea's expectations and hopes resting on my shoulders.

spans.text: I stand in the midst of everyone, feeling what seems like the sum total of Magrasea's expectations and hopes resting on my shoulders.
Everyone, I'm counting on you!
